transcript: just finished watching Beauty and the Beast live, the 30th anniversary celebration, and I really wanted to love this, and there are parts of it I totally did. this cast was so good. like, I need a Beauty and the Beast revival with Joshua Henry as guest on, like, tomorrow. both her and Josh Groban were great, and their finale number, perfection. the way they staged Be Our Guest was 1t of fun. I also really loved Shania Twain in this. I do not understand why they use fat suits in this. that seemed completely unnecessary. the most frustrating thing was that they showed more of the original film than they did of the live cast. and the film is great. I'm glad people got to see it. but that film is available on Disney already. I really wish we could have gotten to see more of this cast, especially because of how diverse it was, and especially because with Little Mermaid, they sang some of the songs from the stage version. for this, they didn't add any of the songs from the stage version. we did get Evermore, which I guess makes sense because we have Josh Groban, so you may as well have him sing his song. The Person I would have rather have had more of the big group numbers. I would have definitely wanted to have Joshua henry's Me. I just felt like there was a lot of missed opportunities here, but what we got of the live cast was really good. I just wanted more from them. anyway, I really hope that we get a Beauty and the Beast revival on Broadway after this, because we're do. we're do. we also still do not have a recorded version of Change in Me, which is a travesty. and I'm really excited for Josh Groban Sweeney now.
